parts.name: DrawerRoot
parts.description: Holds the drawer's open state and its swipe, and shares them with the parts inside it. It is a DialogRoot underneath.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the drawer is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the drawer.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the drawer is open at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when a part, Escape, a press outside or a swipe asks to open or close the drawer. A controlled drawer changes only when `open` does. It is called in a change of its own, after the drawer's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the drawer.

props.name: swipeDirection
props.description: The edge the drawer is swiped out through: `"up"`, `"down"`, `"left"` or `"right"`.

props.name: swipeThreshold
props.description: How far a swipe must travel to close the drawer, in pixels. When it isn't given, half the drawer's size along `swipeDirection`. A fast flick closes it whatever the distance.

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether the drawer is opened with `showModal()`: in the top layer, with a backdrop, the page behind it inert and its scroll locked. As DialogRoot's.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether Escape and a press outside close the drawer. With `false` only its own buttons and a swipe do.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description: Whether a press outside is ignored. Escape and a swipe still close the drawer.

parts.name: DrawerTrigger
parts.description: The button that opens the drawer.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the drawer is open.

parts.name: DrawerPopup
parts.description: The `<dialog>` element, which follows the swipe. Place it against its edge in CSS and translate it by the movement variables. Its `::backdrop` inherits the variables.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the drawer animates out. It stays open until the transitions and animations on it and its descendants finish.

dataAttributes.name: data-swipe-direction
dataAttributes.description: The edge it is swiped out through: `up`, `down`, `left` or `right`.

dataAttributes.name: data-swipe-dismiss
dataAttributes.description: Present when the drawer was last closed by a swipe, until it opens again.

dataAttributes.name: data-swiping
dataAttributes.description: Present while the drawer is being dragged.

cssVariables.name: --drawer-swipe-movement-x
cssVariables.description: How far the drawer has been dragged horizontally, in pixels. `0px` at rest.

cssVariables.name: --drawer-swipe-movement-y
cssVariables.description: How far the drawer has been dragged vertically, in pixels. `0px` at rest.

cssVariables.name: --drawer-swipe-progress
cssVariables.description: The drag towards `swipeDirection` as a fraction of the drawer's size, from 0 to 1.

parts.name: DrawerContent
parts.description: Holds the drawer's content. A mouse press inside it selects text instead of starting a swipe; a touch still swipes.

dataAttributes.name: data-drawer-content
dataAttributes.description: Always present. It marks the area where a mouse press doesn't start a swipe.

parts.name: DrawerTitle
parts.description: A heading that names the drawer. The popup's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

parts.name: DrawerDescription
parts.description: A paragraph that describes the drawer. The popup's `aria-describedby` points at it.

parts.name: DrawerClose
parts.description: A button that closes the drawer.
